Accomplishment
1. Chairman of the Tsunah Foundation(美國慈林基金會董事長) 1998-2005& 2010- 2018

2. One of the key Co-founders of the Taiwanese American Foundation of San Diego and Taiwan Center in San Diego in 1997 (聖地牙哥台美基金會秘書, 董事) 1998-2003 & 2013-2015

3. Co-established the Lai Ho & Wu Cho-liu Endowed Chair in Taiwan Studies at UCSB (台灣研究- 賴和與吳濁流講座教授) 2004

4. Board Member of San Diego County CLERB (Citizens' Law Enforcement Review Board) 2001

5. President of NATWA/Greater San Diego Chapter (北美洲台灣婦女會聖地牙哥分會會長) 2014

6. Co-founder of Pacific Biotech, Inc & Wyntek Diagnostics, Inc

7. Vice President of Operations at Gengyme Diagnostics San Diego, formerly Wyntek Diagnostics, Inc.

8. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 07/2018
